label: Chariot overhang fixes: sliced diagnostic; unchecked Blender output; physical trial pending
conclusions: All four individual projects and the combined plate slice with continuous nominal layers; the original sword/spear gaps are eliminated.
Full-perimeter underbody, grounded wheel contacts, inner horse blends, hip-grown coat, tapered palm and deck-seated robe address the large underside starts.
Selected spear-grip and rear-deck regions have no unaccepted perimeter runs; coat-region maximum is below 0.50 mm and Mage hem-region maximum below 0.13 mm.
Sloped helmet ceilings, General nape and brow remove the long helmet flags while preserving shared head definitions and outer crowns.
Conservative automatic-support/model filament falls by 22.5 to 39.8 percent relative to the baseline, but all four whole-model deposited-layer screens still fail.
Residual flags include internal leg-hole closing contours and small front-rim, mail and attached-detail contours; these are improved print trials, not certified support-free models.
limitations: All four conservative deposited-layer screens still fail; zero-support certification is not claimed.
Perimeter flags include internal hole-closing contours as well as small exposed ledges and attached relief.
No topology/self-intersection validation, independent repeat builds or physical trials were performed.
